component.name: Glitch Softphone
component.summary: Desk phone for your FusionPBX extension

description.p: Glitch Softphone turns your computer into a desk phone for a FusionPBX phone system. Sign in with your extension and you get the features of an office desk phone:

ul.li: Busy lamps that show which colleagues are free, ringing or on a call
Blind and attended transfer, call park and call pickup
Call-center queues: join, leave and take a break
A status that can send your calls to voicemail or another number
Contacts, call history and a voicemail lamp

description.p: You need an extension on a FusionPBX server. Some features need a few settings on the server; the project's documentation explains them.

screenshot.caption: The phone, with colleagues' busy lamps
Live lamps for colleagues, call park and the call-center queue

ul.li: Refresh from PBX (F5): load lamps, names and contacts the administrator just changed, without restarting
Lamps no longer repeat the call state in an extra line, and long ringing text is no longer cut off

description.p: Fixes the x86_64 Flatpak, which closed at start-up.
